description: Duplicate alerts, medical history, reminders, interactions, and export stubs. Depends on FEAT-001 (DuplicateAlert, MedicalHistorySummary, Reminder models) and FEAT-002 (conftest.py). These five routers are bundled because they are all simpler CRUD or stub endpoints with no cross-dependencies between them.
steps: Create backend/app/schemas/duplicate_alert.py: MedicineSummary(prescription_medicine_id: str, brand_name: str|None, active_ingredient: str|None, strength: str|None, prescription_id: str, prescription_date: date|None, doctor_name: str|None). DuplicateAlertResponse(id, matched_active_ingredient, match_type, match_confidence, medicine_a: MedicineSummary|None, medicine_b: MedicineSummary|None, reviewed_by_patient, reviewed_at, formulation_notes) with from_attributes=True. DuplicateAlertListResponse(alerts: list[DuplicateAlertResponse], total, unreviewed_count).

Create backend/app/schemas/history.py: HistorySection(type: str, label: str, content: str, source_refs: list[str]). SourceReference(ref_id: str, prescription_id: str, prescription_date: date|None, doctor_name: str|None). SummaryContent(sections: list[HistorySection], source_references: list[SourceReference]). HistorySummaryItem(id, version_number, generated_at, is_current, medicine_count, prescription_count) with from_attributes=True. HistoryDetail(id, version_number, generated_at, is_current, summary: SummaryContent|None). GenerateHistoryResponse(summary_id, status, job_id). HistoryListResponse(summaries: list[HistorySummaryItem], total).

Create backend/app/schemas/reminder.py: ReminderResponse(id, patient_id, prescription_medicine_id, reminder_times: list[str], frequency_display, is_active, created_at, updated_at) with from_attributes=True. Deserialise reminder_times from JSON string in validator. CreateReminderRequest(prescription_medicine_id: str, reminder_times: list[str] with min_length=1, frequency_display: str|None). UpdateReminderRequest(is_active: bool|None, reminder_times: list[str]|None, frequency_display: str|None). ReminderListResponse(reminders: list[ReminderResponse], total).

Create backend/app/services/duplicate_service.py: DuplicateService(db: AsyncSession). list_alerts(patient_id, reviewed_filter, page, page_size) -> (list[DuplicateAlert], total, unreviewed_count). get_alert(alert_id, patient_id) -> DuplicateAlert | None. mark_reviewed(alert_id, patient_id) -> DuplicateAlert: check not already reviewed (409), set reviewed_by_patient=True, reviewed_at=now, commit, return.

Create backend/app/routers/duplicates.py: GET /patients/me/duplicates (200, DuplicateAlertListResponse), GET /patients/me/duplicates/{alert_id} (200, DuplicateAlertResponse), PUT /patients/me/duplicates/{alert_id}/reviewed (200). All require get_current_patient.

Create backend/app/services/history_service.py: HistoryService(db: AsyncSession). generate(patient_id) -> dict with summary_id, status, job_id: check no GENERATING summary in progress (409), get next version_number (max existing + 1), create MedicalHistorySummary row with status='GENERATING', set all other is_current=False, return dict. (Actual generation worker is out of scope.) list_summaries(patient_id) -> (list[MedicalHistorySummary], total). get_summary(summary_id, patient_id) -> MedicalHistorySummary | None: parse summary_json into SummaryContent if present.

Create backend/app/routers/history.py: POST /patients/me/history/generate (202, GenerateHistoryResponse), GET /patients/me/history (200, HistoryListResponse), GET /patients/me/history/{summary_id} (200, HistoryDetail). All require get_current_patient.

Create backend/app/services/reminder_service.py: ReminderService(db: AsyncSession). list_reminders(patient_id) -> (list[Reminder], total). create(patient_id, data: CreateReminderRequest) -> Reminder: serialise reminder_times to JSON string, create row. update(reminder_id, patient_id, data: UpdateReminderRequest) -> Reminder. delete(reminder_id, patient_id): fetch, verify ownership, delete row.

Create backend/app/routers/reminders.py: GET /patients/me/reminders (200, ReminderListResponse), POST /patients/me/reminders (201, ReminderResponse), PUT /patients/me/reminders/{reminder_id} (200, ReminderResponse), DELETE /patients/me/reminders/{reminder_id} (204). All require get_current_patient.

Create backend/app/routers/interactions.py: POST /patients/me/interactions/check (200): check settings.ENABLE_INTERACTION_CHECK; if False, return {checked: false, reason: 'unavailable', message: 'Interaction checking is not available. Please discuss your medicines with your doctor or pharmacist.'}; if True, return stub {checked: true, medicines_checked: [], interactions: [], disclaimer: 'This check is not yet integrated with a reference provider.'}. Requires get_current_patient.

Create backend/app/routers/export.py: POST /patients/me/export/pdf (501, raise_http_error(501, 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', 'PDF export is not available in MVP')), GET /patients/me/export/{export_id} (501), GET /patients/me/export/{export_id}/download (501). All require get_current_patient.
Update backend/app/main.py: include duplicates.router, history.router, reminders.router, interactions.router, and export.router all under /api/v1 prefix.
Commit: feat: duplicates, history, reminders, interactions and export stubs with tests
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/patients/me/history/generate returns 202 with summary_id and status='GENERATING'
POST /api/v1/patients/me/history/generate twice in a row returns 409
POST /api/v1/patients/me/interactions/check returns 200 with checked=false when ENABLE_INTERACTION_CHECK is not set
python -m pytest tests/test_duplicates.py tests/test_history.py tests/test_reminders.py -v passes
verification: $env:JWT_SECRET_KEY='synthetic-test-secret'; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db'; cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_duplicates.py tests/test_history.py tests/test_reminders.py -v
findings: All 16 tests pass in isolation (py -m pytest tests/test_duplicates.py tests/test_history.py tests/test_reminders.py -v). The full test suite (tests/) shows 429 failures for test_prescriptions and test_reminders when run together — this is a pre-existing in-process rate-limiter cross-contamination issue unrelated to FEAT-004 (test_prescriptions passes in isolation too). Later steps may want to address this by resetting the rate-limiter state between tests in conftest.py. history_service.py attaches _parsed_summary as a transient attribute on the ORM model — later steps that extend the summary detail endpoint should be aware of this pattern. Reminder FK (prescription_medicine_id) is nullable and SQLite does not enforce FKs in test mode, so reminder tests use a synthetic UUID without creating a real PrescriptionMedicine row.
